$comment: The first catalogue release covers one archetype, not all 1440 modules (MVP Architecture §16.3). Israeli B2B wholesale distribution: order to cash, procure to pay, stock, and the Israeli accounting boundary.
notes: Modules listed here are the business-selected set. Their transitive dependencies come from the release and are recorded as technical dependencies, not as scope decisions (Blueprint §13).
Nothing here asserts that a module satisfies a requirement. That is a fit assessment, made per requirement against verified capabilities.
